description: This file defines the HttpService class, which provides methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to an API endpoint, handling JSON serialization/deserialization, and displaying error messages via a toast service.

classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: A service class for handling HTTP communication with an API, supporting GET, POST, PUT, DELETE methods, with error handling and JSON serialization.

methods.name: HttpService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes HttpClient, ToastService, and API URL from configuration.

methods.name: HttpGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URI and deserializes the response to the specified type.

methods.name: HttpDelete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified URI with an ID parameter and deserializes the response.

methods.name: HttpPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON data and deserializes the response, showing an error toast if needed.

methods.name: HttpPut
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with JSON data and deserializes the response.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object to a JSON StringContent.

methods.name: FromHttpResponseMessage
methods.description: Deserializes JSON content from an HttpResponseMessage into the specified type.
